title: For the patients with a normal range of creatinine phosphokinase, how many
question:
For the patients with a normal range of creatinine phosphokinase, how many of them have a positive measure of degree of coagulation?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: normal range of creatinine phosphokinase refers to CPK < 250; positive measure of degree of coagulation refers to KCT = '+' or RVVT = '+' or LAC = '+' ;
